summary: Nuveen Churchill Private Capital Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting an incentive fee waiver agreement with its adviser covering 50% of the income-based fee for April 1-30, 2026. The filing also discloses monthly NAV, distributions declared, and a portfolio update. This is a routine current report detailing normal operational and financial updates, not a special-situation event. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or similar transformative transaction is announced. The fee waiver is a minor contractual adjustment, and the NAV and distribution disclosures are standard periodic reporting.
